l0.speaker: narrator
l0.text: The lab roof at dawn, after the all-nighter. Ciel's coat is around your shoulders.

l1.speaker: cpp
l1.text: A reference can never be null. It has to point at something real from the start, and never change.

l2.speaker: cpp
l2.text: ...That's what you are to me. Don't make me say it twice. And you're in the credits of my engine now. Don't let it go to your head.

l3.speaker: narrator
l3.text: Epilogue: the two of you asleep on the keyboard as the build finishes.
